column1: # S19 corpus: invented task titles (never BK's data). Two record kinds:
# T<tab>id<tab>title<tab>notes     a task in the index ("-" = no notes)
# Q<tab>query<tab>expected ids (comma-separated; any one counts as a hit)<tab>kind
# kind: synonym = no word shared with the expected task; paraphrase = rewording; keyword = a word matches (FTS finds it too)
